# NFL Daily — 2026-11-08 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Lamar Jackson has told Ravens teammates he plans to return later this season after surgery on his fractured, dislocated thumb, with a simple message: just stay alive. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50407561/sources-lamar-jackson-told-ravens-plans-return-26)
- Colts RB Jonathan Taylor trade talks are heating up leaguewide ahead of Tuesday's deadline, with the Giants pulling their multi-pick offer off the table. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50403627/trade-talks-pick-nfl-tuesday-deadline-looming) — also [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/giants-pull-multi-draft-pick-offer-off-table-colts-star-jonathon-taylor)
- Colts QB Daniel Jones is drawing trade interest from multiple teams before Tuesday's deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50403440/sources-colts-engaged-daniel-jones-trade-talks)
- Chiefs GM Brett Veach says Kansas City is looking to trade for a wide receiver before the deadline. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-looking-to-trade-for-wide-receiver-nfl-trade-deadline/)
- Raiders say they've fielded no trade calls on QB Kirk Cousins and plan to keep him. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119486597779394864)
- Elsewhere ahead of the deadline: the Jets won't deal RB Breece Hall, the Ravens keep declining calls on RB Derrick Henry, and the Chargers are saying no on QB Justin Herbert, WR Ladd McConkey and LB Khalil Mack. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119399250983363000)
- Bill Belichick made a surprise return to the Patriots' sideline ahead of their Week 9 game against the Packers. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bill-belichick-surprise-return-patriots-new-england-week-9-showdown-packers/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (quad) may miss Week 10 against the Raiders. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is out Sunday and "questionable at best" for next week's game at Dallas. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-08 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Lamar Jackson has told teammates he plans to return later this season following surgery on his fractured, dislocated right thumb — he's expected out 6-9 weeks. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-return-this-season-told-teammates-ravens-just-stay-alive-thumb-injury) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50407561/sources-lamar-jackson-told-ravens-plans-return-26)
- Jacoby Brissett's job in the meantime: keep Baltimore's playoff hopes alive long enough for Jackson's return. [Garafolo](https://x.com/MikeGarafolo/status/2119424304651882924)
- The Ravens continue to field trade calls on RB Derrick Henry ahead of Tuesday's deadline but keep telling teams he's not available. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119399519972409850)
- Baltimore (4-5) trails Cincinnati and Pittsburgh (both 6-2) by 2.5 games with nine weeks left. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2119484035714207762)

# Rivals — 2026-11-08 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes left Sunday's game against the Jets in pain after a sack, holding his elbow/forearm, but returned to start the next drive. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/patrick-mahomes-elbow-injury-update-chiefs) — also [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2119511287470379124)
- Chiefs GM Brett Veach says Kansas City is looking to trade for a wide receiver before Tuesday's deadline. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-looking-to-trade-for-wide-receiver-nfl-trade-deadline/)
- Bengals routed the Falcons 34-17 in Madrid behind Joe Burrow (24-of-29, 271 yards, 3 TDs) and Ja'Marr Chase (10 catches, 155 yards, TD), moving to 6-2 and into a share of the AFC North lead with the Steelers. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7763501/2026/11/08/bengals-falcons-madrid-nfl-week-9-result-takeaways/)
- Steelers Hall of Fame linebacker Jack Ham was hospitalized after a medical emergency Saturday ahead of the Penn State-Washington game; he's now in stable condition. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/college-football/story/_/id/50410839/hall-famer-jack-ham-hospitalized-medical-emergency) — also [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/pennstatefootball/2026/11/penn-state-great-jack-ham-in-stable-condition-following-medical-emergency-on-saturday.html)
- Browns QB Deshaun Watson cleared the concussion protocol but was inactive Sunday against the Saints, with Shedeur Sanders starting. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2119401356469608874)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Chiefs WR Xavier Worthy left Sunday's game against the Jets with an apparent leg injury and did not return. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills OTs Dion Dawkins (ribs) and Alec Anderson (ankle) are both questionable for Monday's game at Minnesota. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
